meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会从你提供的文本中提取作者的思维特征，按12个认知维度打分，并生成一份认知档案，包含主导模式、推理风格、决策倾向等；若提供多份文本，还会对比不同作者的思维异同。
howto.when: 当你想分析某人的思维方式、认知风格，或要求对比两人的思维差异，或提到「思维模式」「认知档案」「DHDNA」等关键词时触发；你提供文本并想了解作者推理特点时也会触发。

say.text: 分析这段话的认知模式
say.note: Claude 会按12个维度打分并生成认知档案。
Claude 会基于当前对话历史做自我档案分析。

say.text: 比较我和这篇作者的想法有何不同
say.note: Claude 会分别分析并给出对比结论。

howto.what_en: Claude extracts the cognitive fingerprint of any text: scores 12 dimensions, finds dominant/shadow patterns, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint, and outputs a DHDNA profile. Can compare authors or profile the user from conversation history.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, compare thinking styles, or mentions keywords like 'thinking pattern', 'cognitive profile', 'DHDNA'. Also when text is provided and the author's reasoning is asked.

say_en.text: Analyze the cognitive style of this text.
say_en.note: Claude scores 12 dimensions and creates a profile.
Claude profiles your thinking from the conversation.

say_en.text: Compare this author's thinking to mine.
say_en.note: Claude profiles both and synthesizes differences.
